messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need to re-align the cross‑func roadmap sync cadence. Weekly is getting heavy for engineering review cycles. Proposal: move to biweekly + rotating agenda owners. Also want to lock the next two sessions. Thoughts?

alex: Prefer weekly for RFC/design reviews so they don't pile up. If we go biweekly, can we keep an 'urgent triage' ad‑hoc slot? :thinking:

sophie: Rotating owners seems good. Also can we make the meeting 45m instead of 60m? Afternoons are rough for me.

chen: If biweekly, +1 to alternating focus: A = roadmap/priorities, B = RFC/design deep dives. That should keep each session more actionable.

maria: Okay good idea. Proposed concrete plan:
```
- Cadence: biweekly Tuesdays
- Time: 10:30–11:15 PT (45m)
- Start: 2026-04-07
- Rotation: product -> eng -> infra -> product
- Agenda template: 1) Quick round: 5m, 2) Priority conflicts: 15m, 3) RFC/design spotlights: 20m, 4) Action items & owners: 5m
```
Poll: https://tinyurl.com/rw-sync-poll (pls vote)

calendar-bot: Event created: "Crossfunc Roadmap Sync (biweekly)" — Tue Apr 7 10:30 PT — invites sent to #product, #eng-prod. Update event if we decide otherwise.

sam: Heads up — I have a customer call that day at 10:30. I can do 11:00 but not 10:30.

jordan: @sam noted. 11:00 would be better for US folks but worse for EMEA. Could we slide to 10:45 as a compromise? :shrug:

maria: Quick poll showed 5 votes for 10:30, 2 for 11:00. Looks like majority prefers 10:30. Proposal: keep 10:30 for now; if conflicts remain, owners can swap and we can rotate meeting times every quarter. If urgent triage needed we keep ad‑hoc 30m slot.

chen: SGTM. I can take first agenda owner for Apr 7 and handle RFC triage.

sophie: :thumbsup: I'll add a Notion page for the agenda and assign Chen the initial items.
